prospect_summary: Irish Fairways is a Dublin-based bespoke golf DMC running fully personalized golf trips across Ireland and Scotland, with select extensions to Camiral (Spain) and Turkey. Led by PGA professional Josh Adams plus two operations and finance co-founders, the company curates premium itineraries on iconic links and parkland courses (Ballybunion, Waterville, Old Head, Lahinch, Royal County Down, Portmarnock, St Andrews, Royal Troon, Muirfield) paired with five-star hotels, fine-dining, chauffeured transport and cultural side trips. They are a 2026 World Golf Awards Silver nominee for Best Inbound Golf Tour Operator and partner with Failte Ireland and Discover Ireland. Target clients are discerning international golfers - primarily American, with strong appeal to UK, Canadian, and Australian premium golf travelers. Ideal B2B partners are tour operators and luxury advisors in those source markets who already sell Ireland/Scotland golf and need a reliable ground operator.
